title: Claims Audit Rights Exhibit: PBM Services Agreement
content:
A plan sponsor holding a PBM Services Agreement has the right to audit the claims Northbridge Rx billed. The pricing arrangement fixes three terms of that right: the number of claims audits the sponsor may start per contract year, the number of months of claims an audit may cover (the period ending on the audit notice date), and the calendar days of written notice required before an audit starts.

| Pricing arrangement | Audits per contract year | Lookback (months of claims, ending on the notice date) | Written notice before start (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 1 | 12 | 90 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 1 | 24 | 60 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 1 | 24 | 60 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 1 | 24 | 60 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 1 | 36 | 45 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 1 | 36 | 45 |

### Reading the exhibit

- Every arrangement allows 1 claims audit per contract year.
- The lookback widens from 12 months under Northbridge Traditional Pricing to 24 months under the three middle arrangements and 36 months under Northbridge Enterprise Value and Northbridge Coalition Purchasing.
- The notice period shortens in the same direction: 90, then 60, then 45 calendar days.

### Hypothetical illustration of the lookback

Suppose (hypothetically) an audit notice dated on the last day of a month under an arrangement with a 24-month lookback. The claims the audit may cover are those of at most the 24 months ending on that notice date; claims older than that period fall outside the audit.
